item.title: Tourism Demand Prediction Model
item.description: Peru is a country full of history and culture, creating a vast and dynamic tourism sector where small businesses, such as PeruTur, can thrive. PeruTur is ready to scale at a national level, and this project examines the country’s public datasets to identify tourists’ entry points and sites visited. It focuses on targeted marketing, tourist segmentation, and predicting customer demand.
